title: Sparse stability diagrams of LSCF method via strategic pole destabilization using orthogonal matching pursuit
summary: In various engineering fields including mechanical, aerospace, and civil engineering, the identification of modal parameters, including natural frequencies, damping ratios, and mode shapes, is crucial for determining the vibration characteristics of engineered structures. A common method for identifying the modal parameters of structures involves experimental modal analysis using frequency response functions (FRFs) obtained from forced vibration tests.
